newsitem.title: UK: BAA plans Latam air cargo promotion.
newsitem.headline: BAA plans Latam air cargo promotion.

text.p: BAA Plc is planning a UK air cargo "task force" promotional visit to Miami and Lima (Peru) in July/August, although exact dates have yet to be finalised, said its head of cargo development Ian Robinson.
Made up of representatives of different sectors of the British airfreight industry, the aim would be to boost air cargo trading from and via the UK to Latin America.
"Certain Latin American countries were at one time traditionally strong trading partners with the UK but our influence there has perhaps declined somewhat over recent years," Robinson told Reuters.
"But it...offers huge international trading, and therefore air cargo, potential," he said.

Air cargo business from the UK to Latin America, and from continental Europe via London, is currently hampered by lack of capacity but Robinson said "If our visit helps boost trade then this in turn would lead to more capacity being introduced on Latin American routes."
For some years BAA has organised "task force" trips to key overseas airfreight markets, the most recent being to South Africa last year. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
